about:
Sizmek Ad Suite is a global, multichannel ad server used to create, distribute, customize, measure, and optimize campaigns across a variety of screens. It offers multiple options for creative authoring, streamlined campaign management tools, advanced dynamic creative optimization capabilities, and Media Rating Council-accredited measurement.  
Learn more about [Sizmek Ad Suite API documentation.](https://advertising.amazon.com/solutions/products/sizmek-ad-suite)
